integrity: Claims are supported by a complete elementary analytic proof and supplemental exact rational tests. No computer sample is used as an infinite proof. No independent scientific validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the common-composition coefficient locus, not all global centers without the additional two-zero hypothesis of Bravo--Trinidad-Forte. Intermediate-factor strata of degree 2 through n-1 are only bounded in dimension. An equivalent description in earlier trigonometric-composition literature is possible.
title: Exact codimension and two maximal mechanisms for trigonometric composition centers
